attestations.note: The life page heads «Τύπος εορτής: Σταθερή. Εορτάζει στις 27 Ιουνίου εκάστου έτους», the same day as the listing. The page gives him no country, no century and no desert, so he is told from the corpus's thirteen other Lukes by the day alone, which is why the slug and the display name carry it; none of them is kept on 27 June in any calendar. No asterisk and no «Δεν είναι διασταυρωμένη» sentence.
